instruction: A cinematic medium shot of a judo match inside a bright, misty dojo. On the right, the young man with short dark hair (R2) in a white judo gi with a black belt stands in profile, grappling with his opponent. He extends his arm over his partner's shoulder while gripping his sleeve. On the left, a bystander with wavy light brown hair in a white gi spars with him, gripping his shoulder. Bright daylight streams from the background windows, creating a soft haze and high-key illumination.
elements: R2 extends an arm over R1's shoulder while gripping R1's sleeve
R1 grips R2's shoulder while sparring with him
R2 has the sleeve-gripping role and R1 has the shoulder-gripping role in the grapple
R1 and R2 are engaged in a judo grappling match
a judo gi sleeve is used as a contact point in the grapple
the scene is inside a bright, misty dojo
